fusions.name: Spade Bash
fusions.desc: Brings the flat down and deals 15 damage, leaving the target 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds and stunned for 1 second.

fusions.name: Heaped Load
fusions.desc: Heaves a shovelful of earth at the first enemy in line for 28 damage. It bursts on impact, dealing 80% of that to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Raised Berm
fusions.desc: Heaps a bank of earth 5 tiles long for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Dug In
fusions.desc: When your health is full, you gain a ward that absorbs 15% of your maximum health for 8 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
